findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_business, start_inbox, check_dns, room_open, room_wait · Private data: get_business, report_door, ask_business, request_quote, request_booking, register_business, start_inbox, check_dns, room_open, room_join, room_send · Public sink: ask_business, request_quote, request_booking, start_inbox, room_open, room_join, room_send, room_wait · Destructive: update_business, start_inbox, room_leave.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_business, start_inbox, check_dns, room_open, room_wait · Private data: get_business, report_door, ask_business, request_quote, request_booking, register_business, start_inbox, check_dns, room_open, room_join, room_send · Public sink: ask_business, request_quote, request_booking, start_inbox, room_open, room_join, room_send, room_wait · Destructive: update_business, start_inbox, room_leave

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
